QorCap v0.3.33: audible challenge alert and scorebug re-anchor

`receipt.v0.json` is unchanged. Nothing new is written to the receipt or a checkpoint.

- When QorTime posts a liveness challenge, the console plays a loud three-beep clip, shows a Windows toast with the prompt, and flashes the console caption and taskbar button until the window is focused. These alerts passed CI and review but have not yet been tested on real Windows audio, toast or taskbar hardware. The alerts run on a separate worker after the challenge is recorded, so the issued and deadline times do not move. Set `QORCAP_CHALLENGE_BEEP=0` to skip the clip; the old `MessageBeep` still runs. PR #83.
- The standard-bar scorebug reader re-anchors a stuck score lock when the same new score keeps passing the existing gates. On an unresolved disagreement it publishes null scores and winner `unknown`, unless a gated end-menu final is present. Re-anchor notes are written to `reanchor_notes.jsonl` in the match bundle, not to the receipt. Clock and banner templates cut from held-out matches were removed. PR #76.
- A CI job now compares the vendored contracts against QorTime main. It currently fails because the vendored files lag QorTime #70; a re-vendor is in progress. PRs #72, #74.
- CI runs the sidecar scorebug reader tests on Linux and Windows. PR #73.
